name: Nåttarö
description: A compact but demanding Nåttarö loop from the ferry-side service cluster, mixing easy gravel road through the holiday-village area with technical east-coast walking over rocks, roots, shingle beaches and sandy coves. The strongest visitor themes are Storsand and Skarsand, Östermarsfladen/Östermarviken, Vänsviken, the snorkel trail, Drottninggrottan and the island's reserve rules.
utilities: Sparse visitor bins exist at camping/Östermarsfladen and selected service areas, but SAT asks visitors to carry trash back to the mainland where possible.
Guest/customer shower facilities exist at stugby/guest harbor contexts; do not import as free public trail showers.

facilities.name: Nåttarö Handelsbod
facilities.description: Seasonal grocery store near the ferry-side service cluster, selling food, camping supplies and practical island items. Iteration 4 treats the operator's 2026 page as current and the OSM opening_hours=closed value as stale 2025 metadata; display as seasonal/check-current-hours resupply, not year-round dependable resupply.

facilities.name: Bryggkiosken
facilities.description: Seasonal kiosk by the steamboat quay with ice cream, coffee and simple snacks. Use check-ahead wording outside high summer and in bad weather.

facilities.name: Östermarkiosken
facilities.description: Small seasonal kiosk by Östermarsfladen/Östermar with ice cream, coffee, drinks, snacks and beach items. Iteration 3 moved this to the mapped kiosk-building coordinate; it may also handle bread preorders from Handelsboden.

facilities.name: Nåttarö Krog
facilities.description: Seasonal restaurant near the ferry/service cluster. Operator sources should override OSM reservation snippets: normal table booking is not offered, while larger group menus may be prebooked. Use check-current-hours wording until the operator publishes exact 2026 daily times.

facilities.name: Sixtens Bodega
facilities.description: Seasonal pizza, ice-cream and takeaway/cafe point beside the service house. Keep as secondary-priority food because it is real and public when open, but customer toilets must not become public trail toilets. Ignore stale third-party/OSM closure snippets when they conflict with the current operator page.

facilities.name: Nåttarö camping
facilities.description: Designated 24-hour camping near the central service cluster. Iteration 4 operator rules: open from Valborg to the last weekend in September, closed on Midsummer Eve, maximum seven nights, 18+ without guardian, two dry toilets at the tent area, water in the dish room, a grill place near the tent area and 2026 tent fees of 60 SEK per tent/night or 120 SEK for larger tents. Reserve rules still apply outside the designated campsite; prefer the Swedish operator practical-info page over stale translated lodging pages.

facilities.name: Nåttarö ferry quay public dry toilet
facilities.description: Accessible public dry toilet near the ferry quay/service cluster. Länsstyrelsen lists an adapted dry toilet near the ferry pier and OSM tags the mapped toilet as official and 24/7.

facilities.name: Östermarsfladen dry toilets
facilities.description: Dry toilets at Östermarsfladen/Östermar. Supported by Länsstyrelsen and OSM; treat the paired mapped toilets as a single service cluster.

facilities.name: Nåttarö Storsand dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet serving Storsand/Stora Sand. Iteration 2 confirms it is route-relevant and importable; keep a source-currentness caveat because the OSM node has malformed check_date metadata.

facilities.name: Nåttarö west/harbor service-cluster drinking water
facilities.description: Normal public water marker for the west/harbor service cluster by the ferry quay/guest harbor, anchored on the signed Dricksvatten tap. Iteration 5 found additional OSM drinking-water=yes taps around the west/camping/lodging service area, but keeps them as cluster evidence rather than separate normal pins.

facilities.name: Östermarviken fire pits
facilities.description: Clustered designated fire-pit area around Östermarviken/Östermarsfladen. Iteration 2 moves the marker to the west/southwest shore cluster rather than the broader bay coordinate; use only when fire bans allow and never directly on rocks.

facilities.name: Skarsand fire pits
facilities.description: Clustered designated fire-pit context at/near Skarsand. Iteration 2 separates this from the beach marker and uses the photo-backed OSM/Grillplatser cluster.

facilities.name: Storsand fire pit
facilities.description: Clustered designated fire/grill context at Storsand/Stora Sand, using a route-proximate 2025 photo-backed OSM/Grillplatser marker. Fire bans override.

facilities.name: Vänsviken fire pit
facilities.description: Designated fire/grill context at Vänsviken, the southern/eastern bay rest area named by SAT and community route guides, using the photo-backed Grillplatser/OSM marker.

facilities.name: Nåttarö Storsand / Stora Sand
facilities.description: Long, shallow sandy east-coast beach and one of Nåttarö's signature visitor destinations. Also appears as Storsand, Stora Sand and Storsandviken in sources.

facilities.name: Skarsand
facilities.description: Smaller, quieter sandy beach on the east coast north of Storsand, reached on the technical coastal section after Östermar.

facilities.name: Nåttarö snorkel trail
facilities.description: Marked snorkel trail near the west-side bathing/service cluster, with underwater signs and buoy-marked ecology context.

facilities.name: Vänsviken
facilities.description: Quieter southern/eastern sandy bay and SAT rest area with swimming-rock and barbecue context.
